title: Tater Tot Breakfast Casserole
subtitle: Crispy tater tots baked with eggs, bacon, and melty cheese.
description: Adapted from classic Midwest tater tot hotdish tradition for firehall breakfast: frozen tater tots layered with crispy bacon, scrambled eggs, and cheddar baked until the top is shatter-crisp and the center hits 165°F.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Tater Tot Breakfast Casserole in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch Bacon. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 400°F. Grease a deep 9x13 pan. Cook bacon until crisp, drain, and crumble. Keep bacon fat if sautéing optional peppers. Allow 10–15 minutes for mise en place before heat goes on. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Layer tots and bacon
steps.instruction: Spread half the tater tots in an even layer on the pan bottom. Scatter bacon and half the cheddar over the tots. Add optional sautéed peppers if using. Target 165°F at the thickest part before moving to the next batch. Plan about 8 minutes for this step at crew scale. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Add egg mixture
steps.instruction: Whisk eggs, milk, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until smooth. Pour evenly over the layered tots and bacon so liquid reaches the bottom. Plan about 5 minutes for this step at crew scale. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Top and bake
steps.instruction: Arrange remaining tots on top in a single layer and sprinkle with remaining cheddar. Bake 35–40 minutes until tots are deep golden and center reaches 165°F on a thermometer. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.instruction: Rest 8 minutes so the egg custard sets for clean scoops. Garnish with green onions and serve with ranch or hot sauce at the line. Keep a backup tray at 200°F for firefighters returning from a call — never serve picked-over pans to late crew. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

stationWorkflow: Keep tots frozen until they hit the pan—thawed tots turn mushy in the egg layer.
Use a deep pan so the egg mixture does not overflow during baking.
Check center temp with a probe before pulling—golden tots can hide under-set eggs.
cleanupNotes: Line the pan with parchment for easier release and faster cleanup after cheese bakes on.
Wipe bacon grease splatter from the oven door while still warm.
leftovers: Reheat squares on a sheet pan at 375°F for 10 minutes to re-crisp the tot topping.
Crumble leftovers into a breakfast burrito with extra cheese and hot sauce.
